# RenoBeam

> RenoBeam is an AI renovation estimator IN DEVELOPMENT, for contractors, remodelers, and homeowners. It has not launched: there is no sign-up, checkout, or photo upload, and the website is a waitlist only. Once built, you will upload photos and a short walkthrough video of any space and RenoBeam will return a detailed line-item estimate — labor, materials, quantities, and regional pricing — plus a branded, client-ready PDF proposal, in minutes. It was built by Jacob Fischer, a working remodeling contractor and owner of Revisions Unlimited LLC in Central Minnesota, so estimates are structured the way contractors actually price jobs.

Planned pricing at launch (USD, billed monthly). Nothing is for sale yet — there is no checkout, no free trial, and no free-estimate offer on the site:
- Solo — $79/mo: 25 estimates/month, photo + video capture, line-item breakdowns, regional price adjustment
- Crew — $199/mo: 100 estimates/month, 5 team seats, branded PDF proposals, price-book customization
- Firm — $499/mo: unlimited estimates, API access, priority support

- [Home](https://renobeam.com/): product overview, features, how it works, pricing, FAQ
- [Blog](https://renobeam.com/blog/): contractor estimating guides
- [How to Estimate a Renovation Job from Photos](https://renobeam.com/blog/how-to-estimate-renovation-jobs-from-photos): the photo-scoping method contractors use, and where AI fits
- [Why Slow Quotes Lose Remodeling Jobs](https://renobeam.com/blog/why-slow-quotes-lose-remodeling-jobs): first-responder advantage in bidding, with worked math
- [Spreadsheets vs. Takeoff Software vs. AI Estimators](https://renobeam.com/blog/contractor-estimating-spreadsheets-vs-takeoff-software-vs-ai): honest comparison of the three estimating approaches
- [Service areas](https://renobeam.com/locations/): all 50 US states and 25 major metros, with market-specific pages
- [Privacy policy](https://renobeam.com/privacy): what the waitlist form collects and where it goes
- [Terms of use](https://renobeam.com/terms): terms for the pre-launch website
